page.title: Settings
page.description: General behavior, privacy, appearance, and advanced integration options.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Check for the latest version, reopen the welcome screen, and review the current release.
updates.installDescription: You're on {{currentVersion}}. Click Install Update to download in the background - the app will close and the installer will launch automatically.

sections.privacyDescription: Control whether runs are uploaded and whether identifying environment data is scrubbed before sync.

fields.installFolderDescription: Path to the KovaaK's install folder used to locate FPSAimTrainer/stats and FPSAimTrainer/performances
fields.startWithGameDescription: Automatically launch RefleK's when you start KovaaK's, RefleK's will also start with Windows
fields.mouseTrackingDescription: Record mouse movement during scenarios (Windows only)
fields.bufferDurationDescription: Minutes of mouse data to keep in memory
fields.screenCaptureDescription: Record screen during scenarios for video replays (Windows only, requires FFmpeg)
fields.resolutionDescription: Resolution used for new capture sessions; changing it while the game is running rotates the capture session immediately
fields.captureFpsDescription: Frames per second for new capture sessions; changing it while the game is running rotates the capture session immediately
fields.sessionGapDescription: Minutes of inactivity before starting a new session
fields.runSyncDescription: Upload completed runs to the RefleK's Index.
fields.anonymousModeDescription: Remove Steam ID and Steam persona name from run environment data before sync uploads.
fields.recentRunsWindowDescription: Only runs from the last N days are loaded and shown
fields.recentRunsMinimumDescription: If the day window has too few runs, include older runs until this minimum is reached

screenCapture.ffmpegHint: Place ffmpeg.exe in the app folder or install FFmpeg.

modals.clearCacheDescription: This will clear all cached data including parsed stats and computed rankings. Your settings and session data will not be affected.
modals.resetDescription: Select which data you want to reset to defaults:
